query:
Smoke-test this workload over exactly one selected transcript.
Call `list_transcripts` to discover the hash_id and segment_count.
Call `segment_count`, then inspect 5 unique 1-based positions with `get_segment` (first, ~25%, ~50%, ~75%, last); if fewer than 5 segments exist, inspect all of them.
Identify the dominant topic of the transcript and return one short paragraph summarizing it.
Respond in the same language as the transcript content.
